title: SteerGR: Steering Generative Recommendation via Sparse Autoencoders for Controllable Game Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.08790v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative recommendation aims to predict item identifiers from user interaction histories, but explicit control over the properties of recommended items remains underexplored. A key challenge is to connect human-readable concepts to internal features whose interventions effectively change the recommended items. To address this, we propose Steerable Generative Recommender (SteerGR), a framework that uses sparse autoencoders for concept-level control in game discovery. SteerGR proceeds through three stages: (i) Concept Definition and Grounding for defining play concepts with an LLM; (ii) Feature Discovery and Selection for discovering candidate features by their concept associations and selecting one by its steering effect; and (iii) Sparse Feature Intervention for amplifying or suppressing selected features to steer recommendations without retraining the recommender. translated_title: SteerGR：基于稀疏自编码器的生成式推荐引导，实现可控的游戏发现
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐旨在从用户交互历史中预测物品标识符，但对推荐物品属性的显式控制仍未得到充分探索。一个关键挑战是将人类可读的概念与内部特征关联起来，使得对这些特征的干预能够有效改变推荐的物品。为解决这一问题，我们提出了可引导生成式推荐器（SteerGR），这是一个利用稀疏自编码器在游戏发现中实现概念级控制的框架。SteerGR通过三个阶段进行：（i）概念定义与接地，使用大语言模型定义游玩概念；（ii）特征发现与选择，根据概念关联发现候选特征，并根据其引导效应选择特征；（iii）稀疏特征干预，通过放大或抑制所选特征来引导推荐，而无需重新训练推荐器。在两个工业级生成式推荐模型上进行了大量实验……
tldr: 提出SteerGR框架，利用稀疏自编码器将人类可读的游玩概念与生成式推荐模型的内部特征关联，通过直接干预所选特征实现无需重训练的概念级可控游戏推荐。
en_tdlr: SteerGR leverages sparse autoencoders to connect human-readable concepts to internal features of generative recommenders, enabling concept-level controllable game discovery via feature intervention without retraining.
